lines.text: Every day, we trust apps with our most private conversations, personal information, and money.
But data breaches keep happening. Millions of accounts exposed. Sensitive information stolen.
And to send a message, share a file, or make a payment, we're constantly switching between different apps.
More apps. More accounts. More risks.
But the biggest threat may still be ahead.
Attackers can capture encrypted data today and store it for the future.
It's called harvest now, decrypt later.
And when powerful quantum computers arrive, encryption that protects us today could become vulnerable.
lines.speak: And when powerful quantum computers arrive, encryption that protects us today could become vulnerable.

lines.text: Introducing Sealr.
A private messaging and crypto payment app, built on QoreChain and designed with post-quantum encryption.
lines.speak: A private messaging and crypto payment app, built on Core Chain and designed with post-quantum encryption.

lines.text: One place to communicate, share files, and move money.
No phone number. No email. Your wallet is your identity.
Getting started is simple.
Create your account, securely back up your recovery phrase, and set your password.
Your private keys stay on your device.
And Sealr AI guides you through the experience.
lines.speak: And Sealer A.I. guides you through the experience.

lines.text: Now, watch this.
Alice sends Bob a private message, then shares a photo.
Before either leaves her device, Sealr encrypts the content.
lines.speak: Before either leaves her device, Sealer encrypts the content.

lines.text: The server handles encrypted data, not readable conversations.
But here's where it gets interesting.
Alice requests five QOR directly inside the chat.
lines.speak: Alice requests five Core directly inside the chat.

lines.text: Bob taps Pay.
The transaction is processed on QoreChain, and the payment confirmation appears right in their conversation.
lines.speak: The transaction is processed on Core Chain, and the payment confirmation appears right in their conversation.

lines.text: No switching apps. No copying wallet addresses.
Just chat and pay.
Privacy matters in groups too.
When Alice removes Carol from a group, Sealr updates the encryption keys.
lines.speak: When Alice removes Carol from a group, Sealer updates the encryption keys.

lines.text: Bob can read new messages.
Carol can't decrypt messages sent after her removal.
Access changes. Privacy stays protected.
Now for the real test.
Let's see what someone intercepting a Sealr message would actually capture.
lines.speak: Let's see what someone intercepting a Sealer message would actually capture.

lines.text: Encrypted data. Not the original conversation.
Next, we run our Q-Day simulator.
lines.speak: Next, we run our Q Day simulator.

lines.text: The demonstration shows how quantum-vulnerable encryption can be compromised.
But Sealr's post-quantum encrypted message remains protected in the simulation.
lines.speak: But Sealer's post-quantum encrypted message remains protected in the simulation.

lines.text: Because privacy shouldn't have an expiration date.
And there's more.
Swap QOR to fUSD, confirm your transaction, and verify it on QoreChain.
lines.speak: Swap Core to F U S D, confirm your transaction, and verify it on Core Chain.

lines.text: Private conversations. Seamless payments. One identity.
Sealr.
Talk. Pay. Stay private.
Today, and beyond Q-Day.
